description: WAL log reader includes the checkpoint LSN itself during replay (>= instead of >), re-applying pre-checkpoint state mutations.
spec_notes: WALLogReader.get_entries_since must strictly check e.lsn > after_lsn.

repo_files.wal_entry.py:
"""Write-ahead log entry definition."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any


@dataclass
class WALEntry:
    lsn: int
    op_type: str  # "SET" or "DEL"
    key: str
    value: Any

"""Database checkpoint metadata."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict


@dataclass
class CheckpointState:
    checkpoint_lsn: int
    data: Dict[str, Any]

tests.test_wal_recovery.py:
from wal_entry import WALEntry
from checkpoint import CheckpointState
from log_reader import WALLogReader
from state_engine import RecoveryEngine


def test_basic_replay_after_checkpoint():
    # Checkpoint at LSN 10: {"k1": "v1_old"}
    cp = CheckpointState(10, {"k1": "v1_old"})
    log = [
        WALEntry(10, "SET", "k1", "v1_old"),
        WALEntry(11, "SET", "k1", "v1_new"),
        WALEntry(12, "SET", "k2", "v2"),
    ]
    reader = WALLogReader(log)
    engine = RecoveryEngine(reader)
    recovered = engine.recover(cp)
    assert recovered == {"k1": "v1_new", "k2": "v2"}


def test_checkpoint_lsn_entry_not_replayed_over_del():
    # LSN 5 was a SET. Checkpoint captured at LSN 5 has {"k": "val"}.
    # Later, at LSN 6, DEL is executed.
    # If LSN 5 is replayed on recovery, but a sequence of edits occurred, re-evaluating must not corrupt delete!
    cp = CheckpointState(5, {"counter": 10})
    log = [
        WALEntry(5, "SET", "counter", 10),
        WALEntry(6, "DEL", "counter", None),
    ]
    reader = WALLogReader(log)
    engine = RecoveryEngine(reader)
    res = engine.recover(cp)
    assert "counter" not in res


def test_no_entries_after_checkpoint():
    cp = CheckpointState(20, {"active": True, "num": 100})
    log = [WALEntry(19, "SET", "active", False), WALEntry(20, "SET", "num", 100)]
    reader = WALLogReader(log)
    engine = RecoveryEngine(reader)
    assert engine.recover(cp) == {"active": True, "num": 100}


def test_multiple_mutations_and_deletions():
    cp = CheckpointState(100, {"a": 1, "b": 2})
    log = [
        WALEntry(101, "SET", "c", 3),
        WALEntry(102, "DEL", "a", None),
        WALEntry(103, "SET", "b", 20),
        WALEntry(104, "SET", "d", 4),
    ]
    reader = WALLogReader(log)
    engine = RecoveryEngine(reader)
    res = engine.recover(cp)
    assert res == {"b": 20, "c": 3, "d": 4}


def test_empty_log_recovery():
    cp = CheckpointState(0, {"init": "data"})
    reader = WALLogReader([])
    engine = RecoveryEngine(reader)
    assert engine.recover(cp) == {"init": "data"}


def test_log_reader_boundary_condition():
    entries = [WALEntry(1, "SET", "a", 1), WALEntry(2, "SET", "b", 2)]
    r = WALLogReader(entries)
    # Since LSN 1 must strictly return LSN 2
    assert [e.lsn for e in r.get_entries_since(1)] == [2]
    assert [e.lsn for e in r.get_entries_since(2)] == []
